definitions.explanation: A large amount of something piled up like a mountain, typically food on a plate.

examples.japanese: ごはん⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{山盛|やまも}りにした。
{山盛|やまも}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦サラダ→サラダ：01364_sarada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I ate a salad with a heaping pile of vegetables.

examples.japanese: ⟦{皿|さら}→皿：00883_sara⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{唐揚|からあ}げ→唐揚げ：04949_karaage⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{山盛|やまも}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{盛|も}られていた→盛る：00292_moru⟧。
examples.english: The plate was piled high with fried chicken.

notes:
Literally "piled like a mountain." Describes food or other items heaped generously on a plate or surface. Can function as a noun ({山盛|やまも}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ごはん) or adverbially ({山盛|やまも}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{盛|も}る→盛る：00292_moru⟧).

FORMS:
⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧ (mountain) + ⟦{盛|も}り→盛り：13696_mori⟧ (serving, piling).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {山盛|やまも}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{盛|も}る→盛る：00292_moru⟧: to pile high, to heap
- {山盛|やまも}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: a heaping serving of ~
- {山盛|やまも}りになっている: to be piled high

REGISTER:
Casual and vivid. Commonly used in everyday conversation about food. Can also be used figuratively: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{山盛|やまも}り (piled up with work).
